    Marti Howl Riders¶

    [!INFO] The Howl on the Drum — Skin, Hoop, and Fang You hear them before you see them — a drum that rings true, a howl that answers it.

    History¶

    The confederated war-riders of Marti — a southern continent tethered to Lumina by the Vennerian Aelefer Channel and descending southwest into permafrost toward the southern polar ice. Marti holds eight nations — Germina, Kut, Oigopol, Kobra, Brase, Cobal, Kramsadar, Maboro — plus the outposts Anos Marti (northern, Anosi) and Vennerian Channel (Marti) (Vennerian). The Howl Riders are how that fractured continent stays one story: wolf-pacts and drum-hoops.

    The pact is old — older than the Vennerian Aelefer Channel cut, older than the colonial flags. Wolf-folk of Kut and Oigopol (wolvesfolk, not wargs — the distinction matters: wolvesfolk talk, wargs eat) and cold-adapted snake people of Kobra made common cause against Brase coldspeople incursions and Kramsadar dragon highland raids. The drum joined later, when Romanium hoops made the signal carry over tundra wind where horn and smoke fail. Now every Marti nation except Kramsadar — the isolated dragon kingdom in its own sky — sends riders to the seasonal muster at the Germina steppe, where Silver Bride's winter arch is lowest and the drums sound longest.

    Anos factors at Anos Marti hire Howl Riders as scouts and pay in Anosi Mark; Venner charters them to patrol the channel approaches. Both are learning that hiring a howl is easier than commanding it.

    Patron¶

    No single patron. The Howl Riders swear by the Wolf — the composite ancestor of the Kut/Oigopol wolvesfolk — and by the Drum as oath-object. Initiation requires tapping a true Martian Drum (wolf-hide over Romanium hoop — a true Drum rings clear when tapped, a clipped one thuds) and holding the note while a wolf howls the denomination back. Cold-snake Kobra riders add their own rite: a hooded passage through a Kobra frost-gorge in silence until the drum finds them.

    Human riders of Germina (multi-ethnic, many descended from Erisdar and Erisdarian Catmen who arrived on Vennerian ships) and dwarf riders of Cobal near the permafrost take the same oath; the wolvesfolk consider this correct — the Drum does not sniff.

    Sigil¶

    A white wolf's head in howl over a taut drum-hoop on a storm-gray field, the hoop rendered in Romanium-blue to show it is hoop, not frame. Companies mark the hoop's diameter as rank: small hoops (patrol), large hoops (war-band). At night the riders add a thin Silver Bride-silver arc above the wolf — the ring under which the muster howl carries farthest.

    Role¶

    Wolf cavalry, tundra scouts, and drum-signal corps. The Riders fight as light and medium cavalry on wargs and wolves (large wolf-like predators — territorial and violent, but bonded as mounts through wolvesfolk mediation), as scouts who can read permafrost, and as the continent's living telegraph: drum-skin stretched over Romanium hoops can relay a message across a valley faster than a rider, and wolf-howls can carry denomination and urgency in tone. Marti saying: if the drum rings clear, pay; if it thuds, cut it open — the assay test every trader knows.

    They are also the continent's herd guard: Marti wealth is herd — wolves, hides, meat, and the skins that become Drum currency itself — and the riders keep herds alive through winter that kills armies.

    Relation to Currencies & Regions¶

    The Riders ride on the coin they are: Martian Drum — hide over Romanium hoop, valued by diameter and skin thickness, backed by Marti herds and hunting where skin is wealth. A Drum stacked as plates clacks unmistakably in any bazaar from Marti to Beast's Bay. Anos factors at Anos Marti exchange Drum to Anosi Mark at the port; Vennerian wardens at Vennerian Channel (Marti) quote Drum to Vennerian Ducat for channel passage.

    Off-continent the Riders trade Drum for Xetian Coil (Xeti) and Luminal Tusk (Lumina) at Beast's Bay, and for Silver Talon when Kutten Fang scalpers need Marti iron — a barter the riders prefer because it keeps the Anos ledger at arm's length.

    🕸️ Connections¶

    [ Marti Howl Riders ] ├── Region: Marti — Kut, Oigopol, Kobra, Germina, Cobal, plus Anos Marti ├── Patron: The Wolf (ancestral wolvesfolk) + the Drum as oath-object; cold rites of Kobra and Germina steppe muster ├── Sigil: White howling wolf over Romanium-blue drum-hoop on storm-gray; Silver Bride-silver arc at night ├── Backing: Martian Drum (wolf-hide + Romanium hoop, herd wealth) — ports exchange to Anosi Mark and Vennerian Ducat ├── Mounts: Wargs/wolves (bonded via wolvesfolk), tundra and steppe cavalry └── See Also: Marti, Martian Drum, Anosi Mark, Vennerian Channel (Marti), Beast's Bay, The Silver Bride, Sousu
